What we ask of you:

-Bring passion to all that you do

-Listen, move fast and think innovatively

-Speak up, have ideas, and share them

-Believe in customer service, and treating every person with kindness

As industry leaders in innovating global airport hospitality, you will work with colleagues from all parts of the world for a truly global experience. You will help and craft services and facilities in over 200 locations in more than 60 international airports across the world.

Who we are:

We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience that is both accessible and quality. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.

With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.

Join our family today.

Together, we'll make travel better.

About the job:

The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the Rio de Janeiro airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller. The General Manager of Operations is responsible for operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction across all services.

Operational Management:

  • Oversee daily operations across Plaza Premium Group portfolio. including partner lounges
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve operational policies and procedures tailored to Plaza Premium Group within the Rio de Janeiro airport system, enhancing guest experience and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor and analyse performance metrics for all services, identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing corrective actions
  • Ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements and company policies, including, labour laws, health &safety, and airports standards.
  • Coordinate with other departments to guarantee integrated operations and outstanding guest satisfaction.
  • Own the customer experience and Net Promoter Score (NPS) across all customer touch points.

Financial Management:

  • Accountable for the P&L, budgeting, forecasting and cost control within the Rio de Janeiro airport system
  • Responsible for hiring, training and engagement.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, hospitality, real estate, or related field (MBA is plus)
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory); Spanish is a plus.
  • 10+ years of experience in senior management, experience in hotels, airport operations & hospitality is an advantage
  • Preference to have a track record in managing multi-service operations within airports or similar industries
  • Proven ability to build long-term partnerships with clients
  • Strong understanding of airport infrastructure and regulatory environments in Central & South America (is a plus)
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and financial acumen
  • Willingness to travel frequently within the region
  • Demonstrates exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence & empathy

title: Computational Scientist
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We seek a talented Computational Scientist with an M.Sc. in Computational Science or Engineering and academic and/or professional experience. A Ph.D. degree with a strong background in Computational Science is a plus. The ideal candidate for this position is an expert in porting complex scientific programming codes to parallel hybrid (CPU+GPU) clusters. You must have a passion for optimizing and improving code speed-up. Excellent problem-solving ability and good oral and written communication skills in both English and Portuguese are required.

You will join a multidisciplinary and diverse team of scientists and engineers committed to delivering high-end computational technologies and tools for the O&G and broader Energy industry.

Qualifications

  • Expert knowledge of modern C++ (e.g., C++11, C++14, C++17).
  • Expert knowledge of GPGPU frameworks/software layers such as CUDA and OpenCL.
  • Expert knowledge of distributed and parallel computing in hybrid (CPU and GPU) clusters.
  • Good knowledge of device-level optimization and GPU architecture.
  • Good knowledge of modern C++ design patterns and software engineering concepts (e.g., template metaprogramming, generic programming, etc.).
  • Ability to work in both Windows and Linux environments.
  • Some experience with programming/scripting languages such as Python and Matlab.
  • Some experience with MPI programming.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proven experience porting legacy serial or MPI/OpenMP code to GPUs.
  • Knowledge of scientific computing (e.g., linear and nonlinear solvers, numerical methods, etc.).
  • Familiarity with computational mathematics (e.g., linear algebra, calculus, matrix decompositions, etc.).
  • Knowledge of PDE discretization methods, such as Finite Element, Finite Volume, or Lattice Boltzmann.
  • Familiarity with open-source scientific computing libraries (e.g., HYPRE, BOOST++, PETSC, DUNE, LAPACK, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CMake, Makefiles, and other tools for multi-platform code compilation.
  • Knowledge of fluid flow physics.

title: Sondador
description:
Resumo da função:

Responsável por realizar operações de perfuração e/ou intervenções de poços (workover) operando sondas, sejam elas hidráulicas ou convencionais; liderar as equipes em diversas atividades, com ou sem sonda, tais como: atividades Rig up/Rig & down (montagem e desmontagem), despressurização de poços, slick line, pescaria, wireline, dentre outras, visando pela segurança operacional, ambiental e da equipe.

Responsabilidades:

  • Conhecer e interpretar os principais dados específicos do poço (profundidade, pressão da formação, densidade do fluido de amortecimento, MAASP, etc), diagrama proposto de equipagem e o diagrama anterior para iniciar/dar continuidade as intervenções do tipo workover
  • Executar as atividades de assentamento de packer: mecânico e hidráulico, corte de cimento e tampões mecânicos (BPP e BPR) obedecendo e tendo conhecimento dos parâmetros necessários como peso sobre broca e circulação
  • Garantir a correta execução de atividades de equipagem com conjunto BCS obedecendo os cuidados necessários com a elevação das cargas para não ocorrer a flambagem, obedecendo os cuidados necessários com o manuseio e operação do cabo BCS, spooler, conectores elétricos (pig tail), instalação de clamps e alinhamento do orifício do PTS do suspensor com o adaptador A3EC
  • Executar inspeções nos equipamentos de manobra (colar de segurança, cunhas manuais e hidráulicas, elevadores de tubo, chave hidráulica) e de elevação (eslingas e cabos) bem como garantir sua integridade antes do início das operações
  • Realizar o check list diário de inspeção do sondador e garantir o correto preenchimento/inspeção dos demais check lists (torrista e plataformista) pela sua equipe orientando os demais sempre que necessário
  • Operar a sonda conhecendo os principais riscos inerentes ao tipo e a capacidade da sonda – em sonda convencional deve garantir a correta execução da tonelada milha
  • Executar e garantir a execução de todos os aspectos de segurança exigidos em atividades em área classificada, trabalho em altura, movimentação de cargas, testes hidrostáticos, H2S, equipamentos rotativos e segurança de poço
  • Planejar de forma antecipada todos os materiais e ferramentas necessários para a intervenção, bem como garantir a integridade dos equipamentos e ferramentas a bordo comunicando ao supervisor qualquer dano ocorrido
  • Garantir que a equipe siga rigorosamente o programa do poço atendendo todos os parâmetros exigidos bem como as normas vigentes de segurança operacional e de equipamentos de ESCP
  • Saber pesquisar e ter em mãos tabelas de cimentação, tabelas hidráulicas, manuais de perfurações, tabelas de tubos e revestimentos, etc.
  • Controlar todos os parâmetros operacionais do workover: peso sobre broca, densidade e viscosidade do fluido, vazão e pressão de bombeio

Exigências do Cargo:

  • Disponibilidade - Amplitude de horário – Plantão noturno - Trabalho Offshore 14x14
  • Experiência como Sondador de sondas tipo HH Drillmec e ou convencional à cabo 250.000lbs(tipo double joint/mesa rotativa) comprovados em carteira de trabalho;
  • Experiência comprovada em assentamento de tampões mecânicos e hidráulicos e obturadores (packers);
  • Experiência em equipagem de poço com coluna BCS;
  • Conhecimento teórico e prático na atividade de perfuração e/ou completação;

Escolaridade mínima:

  • Ensino médio técnico completo

Qualificação A: antes do embarque:

  • Curso Básico de Segurança de Plataforma - CBSP
  • Treinamento de Escape de Aeronave Submersa - HEUT
  • Well Control IWCF – Level 3
  • Programa de Capacitação em Segurança e Saúde no Trabalho - NR37 - Básico

title: Especialista de Controladoria
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar na controladoria societária com foco em normas contábeis nacionais e internacionais, assegurando a correta consolidação das demonstrações financeiras, conformidade regulatória e suporte técnico às auditorias externas e internas.

  • Garantir a correta aplicação das normas contábeis (CPC/IFRS) nas demonstrações financeiras consolidadas;
  • Elaborar, revisar e validar balanços patrimoniais, DRE, DFC e notas explicativas;
  • Realizar consolidação contábil de empresas do grupo, incluindo transações intercompany e ajustes de equivalência patrimonial;
  • Apoiar processos de reestruturação societária, fusões, cisões e incorporações;
  • Atuar como ponto focal técnico junto às auditorias externas e internas, fornecendo suporte e documentação;
  • Realizar análises críticas de contas contábeis, conciliações e validações de saldos;
  • Participar de projetos de melhoria de processos contábeis, automação e compliance;
  • Interagir com áreas como jurídico, fiscal, planejamento e tesouraria para alinhamento de informações societárias;
  • Monitorar atualizações regulatórias e propor ajustes nos processos contábeis conforme necessário.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação completa em Ciências Contábeis com CRC ativo;
  • Especialização (desejável): Pós-graduação ou MBA em Controladoria, Contabilidade ou Finanças;
  • Experiência sólida em controladoria societária, consolidação contábil e elaboração de demonstrações financeiras;
  • Experiência em empresas de auditoria (Big4) será considerado um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento avançado em normas contábeis brasileiras (CPC) e internacionais (IFRS);
  • Domínio de Excel avançado, ERP (SAP) e ferramentas de BI (Power BI).

Informações adicionais

O Que Temos Para Você

title: Assistente Administrativo / Operacional de Loja
description:
Sobre a Boobam

A Boobam conecta arquitetos, clientes e os principais designers e artistas do Brasil em um só lugar. Somos a maior plataforma de design assinado do país, reunindo mais de 1.500 designers e 16.000 peças entre mobiliário e arte. Unimos tecnologia e curadoria para reduzir fricções e tornar o design brasileiro “menos inacessível”.

Depois de consolidar nossa primeira loja em Pinheiros (SP), estamos expandindo nossa presença física com a nova loja Boobam Ipanema, no Rio de Janeiro.

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Assistente Administrativo / Operacional de Loja para atuar de forma presencial, garantindo o pleno funcionamento da loja Boobam.

Esse cargo é essencial para a operação: envolve organização logística, suporte ao time comercial, relacionamento com fornecedores, controle administrativo e apoio à produção de eventos e ativações na loja.

Buscamos um perfil prático, organizado e mão na massa , com olhar atento aos detalhes e capacidade de manter a loja sempre funcional, estética e eficiente.

Responsabilidades:

Logística Interna - Recebimento & Expedição de Peças

  • Receber mercadorias, conferir notas fiscais, verificar avarias e registrar entradas.
  • Organizar o estoque interno de forma eficiente e categorizada.
  • Separar, preparar e acompanhar peças para envio (clientes, arquitetos, transportadoras e logística própria).
  • Controlar o fluxo de entrada e saída no sistema e alinhar informações com o time de vendas.
  • Acompanhar instalações, retiradas e entregas dentro da loja.

Funcionamento & Organização da Loja

  • Garantir que a loja esteja 100% operacional (limpeza, iluminação, climatização, música, aroma, materiais de venda, tablets, etiquetas e embalagens).
  • Identificar e reportar pequenos problemas estruturais à gerência.
  • Abastecer café, água e materiais de apoio.
  • Criar e executar checklists diários e semanais de funcionamento da loja.

Facilities - Manutenção & Prestadores de Serviços

  • Orçar, contratar e acompanhar prestadores de serviços (limpeza, elétrica, pintura, marcenaria, ar-condicionado, vidraçaria, entre outros).
  • Garantir a execução correta dos serviços contratados.
  • Manter calendário de manutenção preventiva da loja.
  • Negociar valores, prazos e escopo conforme orçamento definido.

Atendimento & Suporte Operacional

  • Apoiar clientes em demandas de pós-venda dentro da loja (trocas, dúvidas e retiradas).
  • Dar suporte aos vendedores na separação de peças e informações operacionais.
  • Auxiliar no agendamento de entregas e retiradas com logística própria ou transportadoras.
  • Acompanhar pequenos reparos e análises de peças.

Produção de Eventos & Ativações na Loja

  • Apoiar a organização de eventos, lançamentos, ativações e parcerias.
  • Cuidar da logística dos eventos (mobiliário, fornecedores, catering, listas, apoio geral).
  • Preparar a loja para receber designers, arquitetos, influenciadores e fotógrafos.
  • Garantir organização, desmontagem e retorno visual da loja após os eventos.

Administrativo Geral da Loja

  • Controlar pequenas compras e despesas da loja.
  • Apoiar na gestão de documentos simples (NF de entrada e saída, garantias, chamados).
  • Enviar relatórios operacionais para a gerência.
  • Controlar materiais de escritório, limpeza, ferramentas e insumos.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia em operações de loja, administrativo, logística, estoque ou facilities.
  • Perfil organizado, ágil e atento aos detalhes.
  • Postura prática e capacidade de resolver problemas no dia a dia.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e facilidade para lidar com clientes e fornecedores.
  • Conhecimento básico de sistemas de estoque ou ERP (Omie é um diferencial).
  • Ensino médio completo (superior em Administração, Logística ou áreas correlatas é diferencial).

O que oferecemos

  • Oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa inovadora e em expansão.
  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e dinâmico.
  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado.
  • Benefícios: VR+VT.

Informações Adicionais

  • Modelo de trabalho: Presencial
  • Contrato: CLT
  • Localização: Ipanema/RJ

title: Engenheiro Eletricista
description:
Engenheiro Eletricista | Sistemas Embarcados e Plataformas Marítimas

Sobre a Tidewise

A Tidewise é uma empresa brasileira pioneira no desenvolvimento, integração e operação de sistemas robóticos inteligentes voltados para as demandas da indústria marítima. Nossa missão é acelerar a transição para um setor mais seguro e sustentável, utilizando tecnologia de ponta para aumentar a segurança, confiabilidade e eficiência, ao mesmo tempo em que reduzimos o impacto ambiental e os custos operacionais.

Descrição da Vaga

A Tidewise está em busca de um(a) Engenheiro Elétricista com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de sistemas elétricos embarcados, domínio de ferramentas CAD para projeto elétrico (especialmente SolidWorks Electrical ) e conhecimento em documentação técnica para fabricação e montagem.

Essa pessoa atuará diretamente com as equipes de engenharia, produção e integração de sistemas, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento detalhado, montagem e validação de sistemas elétricos e eletrônicos em plataformas robóticas marítimas inovadoras.

Trata-se de uma posição prática, com impacto direto nos produtos da empresa, que exige organização, atenção aos detalhes, capacidade de lidar com diferentes etapas do ciclo de vida de um projeto e boa comunicação entre áreas.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver projetos elétricos a partir de conceitos e requisitos de sistema , incluindo a definição da arquitetura elétrica, estratégias de controle e interfaces entre subsistemas.
  • Realizar estudos de balanço de carga , dimensionamento de circuitos, proteções, fontes de energia e consumo elétrico dos sistemas embarcados.
  • Desenvolver esquemáticos elétricos, diagramas de conexão e layout de painéis no SolidWorks Electrical, em colaboração com os engenheiros eletricistas.
  • Criar modelos e desenhos 3D de montagem elétrica utilizando o SolidWorks Mecânico (3D) , em colaboração com os engenheiros eletricistas e mecanicos.
  • Realizar projeto e roteamento de placas de circuito impresso (PCBs)
  • Elaborar documentação técnica de montagem e checklists de instalação elétrica.
  • Desenvolver planos e procedimentos de teste para sistemas elétricos e eletrônicos.
  • Troubleshooting de sistemas, tanto em bancada quanto a bordo.
  • Preparar e organizar bancadas de teste e validação.
  • Atualizar a documentação técnica “ as built ” conforme modificações ocorridas durante montagem e testes.
  • Realizar o controle técnico de montagem e supervisar a instalação elétrica.
  • Criação, atualização e manutenção de listas de materiais no sistem ERP (BOMs);
  • Pesquisa de fornecedores e solicitação de orçamentos;

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada com software CAD para projetos elétricos (ex: SolidWorks Electrical, EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical).
  • Experiência com roteamento de PCBs e uso de ferramentas como Altium Designer , Eagle ou KiCAD .
  • Capacidade de desenvolver documentação técnica clara e organizada para montagem e operação.
  • Inglês técnico escrito , com capacidade de leitura e elaboração de documentação técnica.
  • Experiência em ambiente de produção, montagem ou campo, com foco em integração de sistemas elétricos.
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes, com compromisso com a qualidade da documentação.
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar.

Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência com SolidWorks Electrical e SolidWorks Mecânico 3D .
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de automação, incluindo CLPs e microcontroladores .
  • Familiaridade com normas ABNT , especialmente NBR 5410 (instalações elétricas de baixa tensão).
  • Certificação ou conhecimento prático da NR10 – Segurança em Instalações e Serviços em Eletricidade.
  • Vivência em sistemas embarcados, marítimos ou robóticos.
  • Experiência com ERP e processos de compras técnicas.

O Que Oferecemos

  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos inovadores e de alto impacto na indústria marítima e robótica.
  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, dinâmico e em constante evolução tecnológica.
  • Contato direto com todas as etapas do desenvolvimento de produto, da concepção à operação.
  • Salário e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado.
  • Participação em uma empresa que está moldando o futuro da tecnologia naval e robótica marítima.

Junte-se à Tidewise e participe da revolução tecnológica no setor marítimo! ⚡⚓

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Collection Professional - Consultor Sênior
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Descrição do perfil

Responsável por assegurar o desenvolvimento e a gestão das infraestruturas técnicas necessárias para as atividades de cobrança, controlando o processo de cobrança, analisando periodicamente as contas para identificar aquelas que podem requerer procedimentos de cobrança especiais e atuando também nos processos de governança que envolvem a cadeia de cobrança.

Principais atividades

  • Controlar todos os processos da cadeia de Cobrança, com objetivo de garantir a aderência as regras de negócio implementadas e o monitoramento fim a fim de todas as etapas da régua de cobrança;
  • Gerenciar as bases faturadas Vs. Ações de cobrança, mapeando os principais ofensores/oportunidades garantindo a qualidade;
  • Realizar auditorias sobre todas as ações da régua de cobrança, com o objetivo de identificar os principais ofensores em toda cadeia de cobrança e assim atuar junto a TI na solução das inconsistências;
  • Controlar o processo de No Dunning (isenção de cobrança), com o objetivo de garantir a governança desta carteira e seus respectivos motivos, por meio de relatórios e processos de auditoria;
  • Realizar controles SOX da cadeia de Cobrança;
  • Analisar reclamações ANATEL, sobre as ações de cobrança, com o objetivo de identificar as oportunidades sobre os processos sistêmico da cadeia, garantindo a melhoria contínua e redução do índice de reclamações de Cobrança na ANATEL;
  • Controlar todo processo de negativação, tendo interação direta com os fornecedores de Bureaus de Crédito;
  • Desenvolver relatórios que possibilitem o melhor controle da cadeia de cobrança;
  • Participar de War Room junto a TI, para tratar os temas relacionados a cadeia de cobrança;
  • Automatizar processos e Relatórios;
  • Elaborar apresentações executivas;
  • Segmentar listas de contato por perfil e objetivos das ações multicanal;
  • Realizar análises sobre o desempenho nos diferentes canais de contato de cobrança;
  • Monitoramento de métricas como taxa de abertura, cliques, conversões e rejeições;
  • Gerar insights com base nos dados coletados para melhoria contínua;
  • Criar dashboards e relatórios periódicos para acompanhamento de performance.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação

Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Client Services, Interpretation (Language Services | Research | Due Diligence | Remote)
description:
About Us

Cadence ( is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.


Key Responsibilities

You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen on our careers page.


You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.


Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.


Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.



The Job


You will manage multiple projects per day.


Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).


Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).


Here’s how you will interact with a project:


Scoping

  • You will speak with clients via email, phone, or WeChat about their needs
  • You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
  • You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project

Matchmaking

  • Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
  • You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
  • ... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
  • You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction

Executing

  • You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
  • You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
  • You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied

Key Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
  • Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
  • Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plus


Working Hours & Location


  • This is a fully-remote role where you can work from home (WFH )
  • You will work either APAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - LatAm applicants will work AMER hours)
  • Weekends and overnights shifts are available with a commensurate increase in compensation.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary commensurate with experience
  • Paid time off
  • Health insurance
  • Annual allowance for professional development expenses

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)


$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses


We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.


Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.


What You'll Actually Do


High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

description:
Databricks Data Warehouse ArchitectAbout the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience: Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads
  • Familiarity with Airflow , Kafka , or EventBridge
  • Exposure to data privacy and compliance practices (GDPR, CCPA)
Other Details:
  • Location : Latin America (LATAM) region - Remote, USA - Remote
  • Length : 1+ Year

title: English Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

  • Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.

  • Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.

  • Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.

  • Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.

  • Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.
  • Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.
  • Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components.
  • Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.
  • Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.


Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.
  • ERP/MIS background preferred.
  • Print industry knowledge is mandatory.
  • Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
  • Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.

title: Engenheiro de vendas
description:

Sobre a LoopGlobal
A LoopGlobal é um ecossistema industrial formado por quatro pilares estratégicos:
LoopZero – Engenharia, simulação de processos (MAGMASOFT), desenvolvimento de projetos e soluções avançadas para moldes e injeção.

Nosso propósito é entregar soluções completas para o setor de fundição e injeção de alumínio, combinando tecnologia, engenharia, alta performance e atendimento de excelência.

O profissional será responsável por identificar necessidades técnicas, propor soluções completas (máquinas, células, periféricos, automações, simulações e serviços) e conduzir as negociações até o fechamento.

Sugerir melhorias técnicas, automações e soluções customizadas.

Conhecimento em equipamentos como:
Injetoras de alumínio
Fornos
Robôs e automações
Periféricos (dosadoras, termorreguladores, rebarbadores, etc.)

Noções de automação industrial (robôs, sensores, manipuladores, células).
Conhecimento de processos: dosagem, ciclo de injeção, extração, resfriamento, metalurgia.

Oportunidade de atuar com marcas de referência em máquinas e tecnologias.

Buscamos alguém técnico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados, que domine o ambiente de chão de fábrica e saiba transformar conhecimento técnico em soluções comerciais de alto valor agregado.

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Senior Benefits Manager LATAM
description:
The Senior Benefits Manager – Latin America will lead the strategy, design, and management of employee benefits programs across the Latin American region for a global technology company. This role ensures our benefits offerings are competitive, scalable, compliant, and aligned with our mission to attract and retain world-class talent.

You’ll serve as a trusted regional expert—partnering closely with Global Rewards, regional and local HR, Finance, Legal, Operations—to create an exceptional employee experience that reflects our culture of innovation, agility, and wellbeing.


Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive benefits strategy that supports the company’s growth and employee value proposition across Latin America.
  • Act as the regional thought leader on benefits trends, market practices, and digital innovations in the Global Rewards space.
  • Collaborate with Global Rewards and HR leadership to ensure benefits design aligns with global benefits strategy and vision.
  • Consult and guide the benefits team members as well as our brokers on the strategy and objectives for the benefits function overall.

Program Design & Management

  • Design and manage benefits programs—including health, retirement, life, disability, and wellbeing—across multiple Latin American markets (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Chile, Peru).
  • Drive scalability and efficiency through regional harmonization, technology enablement, and vendor consolidation where appropriate.
  • Lead annual renewals, plan design changes, and benchmarking in partnership with global brokers and local consultants.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and performance metrics to ensure best-in-class service delivery.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with local regulations, labor laws, and reporting requirements.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Payroll, and Finance to maintain robust governance and operational accuracy.
  • Monitor legislative developments and assess their impact on program design and cost.

Employee Experience & Engagement

  • Develop compelling communication strategies that help employees understand and value their benefits.
  • Partner with internal communications, HR, and local teams to integrate benefits into broader employee experience and wellbeing initiatives.
  • Champion wellbeing, inclusivity, and flexibility in benefits programs to meet the diverse needs of our workforce.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Leverage data and market insights to drive benefits strategy and cost management decisions.
  • Track and report key metrics related to participation, utilization, and employee satisfaction.
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and digital transformation to enhance efficiency and employee experience.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience with a leadership position managing employee benefits in a multi-country regional role across Latin America.
  • Proven success in benefits management within a highly matrixed, high-growth technology or multinational environment.
  • Deep understanding of regional benefits practices, legislation, and market dynamics.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.


Preferred Skills & Attributes

  • Passion for innovation, technology, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience with HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors).
  • Skilled at balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution.
  • Culturally fluent and adept at influencing across diverse teams.
  • Commitment to creating inclusive, employee-centered benefits programs.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS)
description:
You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. That’s the spirit of the community you’ll find at Orbia: where the purpose to advance life around the world drives our global team of over 23,000 every single day.

From creating solutions to deliver clean water, secure food supplies and reliable information to steering material advances that power the future of green and smart cities, transportation, and healthcare, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we live for.


Fluor & Energy Materials , an Orbia business, is looking for a SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS) to be based at México, Colombia or Brazil !


Job Summary/ Purpose

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).


Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.
  • Participation in CAB or coordination with IT Service Desk meetings when needed.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.


Knowledge/ Experience Required

  • Good understanding of SAP ECC and S/4 Technical and Development functionalities (BTP, Basis, ABAP, Fiori/JAVA, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.


Behaviors that can help you succeed at Orbia:

  • Develop yourself & Others
  • Foster Collaboration & Inclusion
  • Drive Results
  • Provide Vision & Direction


We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.

Conhecimento em frameworks como Ktor ou Spring Boot com Kotlin. Boas práticas de programação funcional e orientada a objetos em Kotlin. - Uso de coroutines para programação assíncrona. - Testes automatizados com JUnit, MockK ou Kotest. Java + Spring Boot. Experiência com Spring Boot e seus módulos (Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Cloud). - Uso de JPA/Hibernate para persistência de dados. - Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e GraphQL. - Testes com JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers. Python. Conhecimento básico ou intermediário para **scripts, automação e integração**. - Experiência com frameworks como **FastAPI ou Flask** é um diferencial. - Manipulação de dados com **Pandas e NumPy** (caso necessário). **AWS (Cloud)** - Experiência com **AWS Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, API Gateway e IAM**. - Infraestrutura como código (**Terraform, AWS CDK ou CloudFormation**). - Monitoramento e logging com **CloudWatch**. - Conhecimento em **ECS, EKS ou Kubernetes** é um diferencial. **Outros Conhecimentos Desejáveis** - Experiência com **CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD)**. - Banco de dados **SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB)**. - Mensageria com **Kafka ou RabbitMQ**. - Containers e Docker. - Arquitetura de microsserviços e eventos. Integração com AWS e Infraestrutura Desenvolver e otimizar soluções utilizando AWS Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, API Gateway e RDS. Criar pipelines de infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou AWS CDK). Implementar monitoramento e logging com AWS CloudWatch e Prometheus. 3. Processamento e Automação de Dados Construir pipelines de processamento de dados com Kafka ou AWS Kinesis. Criar automações e scripts auxiliares em Python para análise de dados, ETL ou machine learning. 4. Segurança e Performance Implementar OAuth2, JWT ou AWS Cognito para autenticação e autorização. Monitorar performance e escalabilidade, otimizando queries e serviços. 5. DevOps e CI/CD Automatizar deploys utilizando Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/Fargate ou EKS. Configurar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). 6. Colaboração e Melhoria Contínua Trabalhar em equipe, revisando códigos (Code Review) e propondo melhorias. Manter documentação técnica clara e atualizada. Participar de decisões arquiteturais e estratégias de evolução do sistema.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;
  • Experiência com Orchestration Management (OM), incluindo decomposição de pedidos e desenvolvimento de planos de orquestração para processos complexos e multi-step;
